name: NCD0805R1
title: NCD0805R1 chip LED, 2.0 × 1.2 mm, 620 nm dominant
summary: A single red light-emitting diode in a 2.0 mm by 1.2 mm surface-mount chip package, 1.1 mm tall overall. At 20 mA it has a 630 nm peak and a 615 to 630 nm dominant wavelength, gives 50 to 230 mcd over a 130° viewing angle, and drops 1.5 to 2.6 V. It is rated for 25 mA continuous, 5 V reverse and 65 mW, and comes as 3000 lamps on 8 mm carrier tape.
